rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_slack.go guardOutboxMaxPendingAge: the generous age floor (72h) past which boundUndeliveredOutbox drops an UNDELIVERED guard-session Slack status card from the .dispatch-runs/slack-outbox spool on the no-token finalize path, bounding a spool that can never drain on a headless seat (#5354, census #5345 row 10).
rows.distinction: The retention AGE FLOOR for UNDELIVERED outbox rows on the leak-fence path - NOT slackoutbox RetainPosted/RetainDead (the windows that govern already-DELIVERED rows) and NOT resolveGuardSessionsToken (the missing token whose absence is the leak's cause, not its bound).
